title: North Shore Nest – Entire House
house_rules: Check-in is from 3:00 pm to 11:00 pm. Please tell us your arrival time in advance.
Check-out is by 11:00 am.
Guests must show a photo ID and a credit card at check-in.
Guests under 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
Children of all ages are welcome. Guests 18 and older are charged as adults.
A crib for children aged 0–3 is available on request for $25 per night, paid during your stay. There are no extra beds.
Pets are allowed on request. Charges may apply.
No smoking inside. Smoking is allowed only in the designated outdoor area.
No parties or events, including bachelor/bachelorette parties.
Special requests are subject to availability and may cost extra. Available for an extra charge: daily housekeeping, ironing, dry cleaning, babysitting and airport shuttle.
description:
Have the whole North Shore Nest to yourselves: a renovated historic home with 3 bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a kitchen, a dining area, a lounge with a sofa and TV, and a terrace. It sleeps up to 7 guests, with three queen beds and a twin bed. Ideal for families, groups and friends traveling together.

Every bedroom has air conditioning, heating, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a wardrobe and linens. Free Wi-Fi throughout. The house has smoke alarms, a carbon monoxide detector and a security alarm.

The house is in Pittsburgh's North Shore Historic District, perfect for games, concerts and exploring the city: 3 minutes to Acrisure Stadium (Steelers) and 5 minutes to Downtown Pittsburgh, with quick access to restaurants, bars, museums, the casino and the riverfront trails. It's about 0.6 mi from the Pittsburgh Children's Museum and an 8-minute walk to the National Aviary. Nearby: the Andy Warhol Museum 1 mi (about a 19-minute walk), PNC Park 1.1 mi, the Carnegie Science Center 1.3 mi, Point State Park 1.5 mi, the Cathedral of Learning 4.4 mi and the Pittsburgh Zoo & PPG Aquarium 7 mi. North Side Station (train) is 0.9 mi away and Pittsburgh International Airport 13 mi. Free public street parking is available nearby (no reservation needed).
